title: Documents Needed When Registering a Business in Nepal (Checklist)
metaDescription: A complete document checklist for business and company registration in Nepal. Citizenship copies, MOA/AOA, rent agreements, and promoter declarations.
h1: Documents Commonly Needed When Registering a Business in Nepal
directAnswer: To register a business in Nepal, promoters must provide verified copies of Nepali Citizenship Certificates for all shareholders/directors, passport-sized photographs, drafted Memorandum and Articles of Association (MOA/AOA), registered office rental agreement with land ownership certificate (Lalpurja) copy, and municipal Ward recommendation letters.
author: Lalitpur Advisory Research Desk

sections.h2: The Complete Document Preparation Master Checklist
sections.contentHtml:
Having all physical and digital scans prepared prevents delays and rejection during OCR scrutiny:

1. Identity Documentation (Promoters & Directors)

  • Color scanned copies of valid Nepali Citizenship Certificates (Nagrikta) of all promoters.
  • For foreign investors: Notarized passport copies, board resolutions, and Department of Industry FDI approvals.
  • Passport-sized photographs of all proposed directors.

2. Constitutional Legal Documents

  • Memorandum of Association (Prabandha Patra) prepared in standard OCR Nepali font format.
  • Articles of Association (Niyamawali) signed across every page by all promoters.
  • Formal promoter agreement letter or unanimous consent resolution.

3. Registered Office Proof (For Ward & Tax Office)

  • Formal Commercial Lease Agreement executed with property owner.
  • Copy of Land Ownership Certificate (Lalpurja) of the commercial building.
  • Property owner citizenship copy and latest municipal house tax receipt.

sections.h2: Formatting Requirements for the OCR Digital Portal
sections.contentHtml: OCR portal uploads require PDF documents formatted cleanly with clear promoter signatures. Unclear scans or mismatched Nepali spellings in promoter names are the primary cause of rejection. Discover our complete incorporation document preparation services.

faqs.question: Can a company be registered at a residential home address in Nepal?
faqs.answer: Yes, provided the lease agreement specifies that a designated portion of the property is utilized as the registered corporate office and the local Ward Office grants business registration.
